decisions.decision: Use XRPLWin same-indexer values for a comparative observation only; require raw validated-ledger reproduction before canonical feature admission.
decisions.reason: USDC 6.02M and RLUSD 712.52M are same-provider values, but raw XRPL RPC/account_lines were not queried.

decisions.decision: Classify as a permissionless liquidity route, not a Circle-Ripple partnership.
decisions.reason: The pool is on XRPL and has visible reserves/trades; no corporate agreement is implied.

decisions.decision: Record 30-day net redemptions as issuer-level supply contraction; do not label as capital rotation into XRP.
decisions.reason: No destination asset or corridor-level flow attribution is provided by Circle's transparency data.

decisions.decision: Treat reserve balances and interest rates as primary Circle earnings drivers while tracking Arc/USYC/CPN/StableFX diversification.
decisions.reason: Circle reports 95.2% of Q2 revenue from reserve income and explicitly links it to circulation and reserve return rate.

decisions.decision: Model Coinbase as a diversified distribution/custody/market/credit/derivatives platform, not simply a spot exchange.
decisions.reason: Q3 filing reports falling spot volume and MTUs but all-time-high average USDC balances, resilient derivatives, and growth in DEX and borrowing/lending.

decisions.decision: Do not use Q3 net income as a direct measure of underlying trading strength.
decisions.reason: $715.0M of $718.7M net income was offset by investment-asset fair-value gains; operating income was $61.7M.
